title: Repeat a String
prompt: A label printer needs to repeat short text a specific number of times. Write a function that returns the text repeated count times. If count is 0, return an empty string.

explanation.beginner:
Example: repeatString("ha", 3) produces "hahaha". The result must follow this precise rule: A label printer needs to repeat short text a specific number of times. Write a function that returns the text repeated count times. If count is 0, return an empty string. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns empty for zero”: input ["x",0] produces "". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.

Tempting mistake: Do not hard-code the first example: the returns empty for zero case changes the input contract’s boundary or shape. Compare the actual outputs rather than only checking whether both are truthy.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.
